bodies.linkedin:
The LLM extraction path automatically degrades to the deterministic path if an error occurs, ensuring generation never breaks.

This Equity Research Report Generator produces PDF notes that mirror the layout of Geojit-style reports. The system supports PDF, CSV, and TXT input formats while using ReportLab and matplotlib for rendering charts and documents.

Developers can achieve a pixel-for-pixel match of a specific Geojit PDF by modifying the theme, geometry, and section spacing in the configuration files. The underlying data model and extraction logic remain unchanged during this process.

Missing fields in the input data are rendered as 'NA' in the final report. The project is built using Python 3.11, FastAPI, and uvicorn.

These generated reports are not investment advice.

bodies.thread:
The LLM extraction path automatically degrades to the deterministic path on any error, ensuring report generation never breaks.

This system supports PDF, CSV, and TXT input formats to feed the extraction engine.

Missing fields in the input data are rendered as 'NA' in the final report.

The project uses Python 3.11, FastAPI, and Uvicorn to handle the backend logic.

Users can achieve a pixel-for-pixel match of a Geojit PDF by modifying theme, geometry, and section spacing in configuration files.

The data model and extraction logic do not require changes to match a specific PDF style.

Automating the creation of equity research reports is achievable through a modular system that combines flexible data extraction with a standardized PDF rendering pipeline.
